objective: The file-media editor presents a coherent compact form-field hierarchy on desktop and mobile while preserving existing entry behavior.

requirements.statement: The file-media title and add action must use the same compact field hierarchy as surrounding form controls.
acceptance: The title no longer appears as a section heading
The add action shares the title row with compact emphasis
counterexample: The add action remains visually detached

requirements.statement: Every path row must use a stable aligned index-input-delete layout.
acceptance: Single and multiple rows share the same columns
All row controls remain vertically centered
counterexample: Side columns dominate or misalign with the input

requirements.statement: The layout must remain usable without page horizontal overflow on required mobile and desktop viewports.
acceptance: 375x812, 390x844, 430x932 and desktop have no document horizontal overflow
Input and delete action remain reachable

requirements.statement: Existing file-media state, validation and payload behavior must remain unchanged.
acceptance: Selecting file media creates the first row
Add and delete update only the intended row count
Frontend build passes without API changes
counterexample: The visual fix changes payload or breaks add/delete

invariants: Existing handlers and validation remain authoritative
No dependency, backend, database, commit or push changes
constraints: Product edits limited to ReleaseApplicationDrawer.vue and release-prototype.css
Use existing Element Plus controls and CSS variables
non_goals: Add panels, file browsing or instructional copy

assumptions.text: The defect is localized to file-media markup and CSS.
assumptions.basis: Read-only inspection locates the full surface in one template line and CSS lines 339-354.
assumptions.falsifier: Browser inspection proves a global layout rule causes the defect.

decisions.question: Which visual structure should be used?
decisions.source: User selected option 1 and confirmed design revision 1.

measurement_intents.candidate_sensor: Authenticated browser screenshot and DOM styles

measurement_intents.observable: Row grid columns and control alignment for one and multiple rows
Document overflow and control bounds at required viewports
Row-count changes and successful type/build checks
measurement_intents.candidate_sensor: Browser interaction plus npm production build
